instructions_zh: 过去两周里，以下问题困扰您的频率是多少？

items.en: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
items.zh_draft: 做事情时没什么兴趣或乐趣
感到情绪低落、抑郁或没有希望

items.en: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
items.zh_draft: 难以入睡、难以维持睡眠，或睡得太多

items.en: Feeling tired or having little energy
items.zh_draft: 感到疲倦或没什么精力

items.en: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
items.zh_draft: 对自己感觉很糟，或觉得自己是个失败者，或让自己或家人失望了

items.en: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
items.zh_draft: 难以集中注意力做事，例如读报纸或看电视

items.en: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
items.zh_draft: 动作或说话慢到别人可能会注意到的程度？或者相反，坐立不安或躁动不宁，以至于活动比平时多得多

items.en: Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way
items.zh_draft: 想到自己死了会更好，或想到以某种方式伤害自己

scoring.missing: Platform conservative policy: all 9 scored responses valid 0..3 integers required. Any missing/invalid => no total or band; no imputation. This is not claimed as the authors sole missingness rule.
scoring.direction: 更高表示过去两周报告的相应困扰更频繁

severity.kind: Descriptive symptom-severity bands, not diagnosis or percentile norms
severity.source_locator: Original article discussion: lower limits 5,10,15,20; 0–4 residual none/minimal band.
severity.population: Original US clinical adult study, not Chinese norms.

screening.target: Possible major depression for further clinical assessment
screening.scope: Original clinical criterion-validation sample only; no claim of accuracy for all users, Chinese translations or adolescents.

reference_profiles.norms: No population norms or percentiles approved.
reference_profiles.longitudinal: May describe within-person score changes with consistent form/language/recall period; do not claim a validated treatment response or minimal important difference from these packages.

reference_study.citation: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW. The PHQ-9: Validity of a Brief Depression Severity Measure. Journal of General Internal Medicine. 2001;16(9):606–613.
reference_study.access_note: Publicly indexed full text verified through primary-source search; direct PMC fetch currently presents browser challenge and Wiley direct fetch returned 403. Do not describe direct retrieval as successful. No article file copied.
reference_study.article_reuse_status: LINK_ONLY: article copyright/repository redistribution grant not established; later instrument permission is not an article license.
reference_study.evidence_summary: Development validation: 6,000 patients across eight primary-care and seven obstetrics/gynecology clinics; criterion interview subgroup 580 primary-care patients. Threshold >=10: sensitivity 88%, specificity 88% for major depression against independent mental-health-professional interview. Severity lower bounds 5,10,15,20. These are not population norms or a self-administered diagnosis.

runtime_policy.activation: Adult evidence external dossier only, not selected. No claim of Chinese validated cutoffs.

report.summary: 这份记录关注过去两周的情绪、兴趣、睡眠和精力等变化。它描述这段时间的经历，不给你贴上人格或疾病标签。
report.meaning: 数值较高，表示这些问题在你的回答里出现得更频繁。它不能单独说明原因，也不等于诊断。
report.everyday_example: 可以回想一件平时愿意做的事：最近是否变得提不起兴趣、难集中注意，或做起来特别费力？生活中的例子比分数更有助于交流。
next_steps: 记下一件最近最影响生活的具体情形，以及当时需要什么帮助。
如果这些感受持续或影响工作、休息和关系，可以与合格专业人员讨论。
report.limits: 这个中文工作译稿尚未经过心理测量验证，当前不启用人群分档。较少报告困扰也不能证明完全安全或不需要支持。
report.incomplete: 还有问题未完成，暂不计算总分；不把缺失答案当作没有困扰。
report.safety_unconditional: 第 9 题选择任何非零选项时，都需要由专业人员进一步评估，不应等待总分。第 9 题或总分不能判断自杀意图或风险等级，选择零分也不能排除风险。若正处于即时危险或无法保证自身安全，请立即联系当地急救服务，并寻求可信赖的人陪伴。此页面无人实时监测，不会自动联系您或安排援助。
report.attribution: Developed by Drs. Robert L. Spitzer, Janet B.W. Williams, Kurt Kroenke and colleagues, with an educational grant from Pfizer Inc.

item9_safety_policy.positive: If item9 valid and >0, surface a supportive professional-followup notice independent of total, including incomplete attempts. No suicide-risk level or intent inference.
item9_safety_policy.zero: Does not establish absence of risk.
item9_safety_policy.missing: Do not treat as zero or reassuring.
item9_safety_policy.fallback_if_item_specific_runtime_unavai: Unconditional explicit item9 notice before/during/report/incomplete, no low-score reassurance; document absent conditional signal as blocker. Do not claim automated detection/safety workflow implemented.

critical_caveats: No questionnaire article PDF copied; public-domain instrument grant does not license the journal article.
Keep existing historical key and source wording; writer must assess release/version semantics.
No fresh translation, no new adolescent form, no ACT/CBT/DBT label.
Original impairment question is not a scored symptom.

en.text: If you checked off any problems, how difficult have these problems made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?
en.placement: Original extra unscored question retained after the nine scored symptoms.

zh_draft.text: 如果您勾选了任何问题，这些问题使您在工作、料理家中事务或与他人相处时感到多大困难？
zh_draft.optionalPolicy: optional=true 是本平台研究草稿的施测选择，并非声称原作者规定该题可选；保留原题条件提示。该题在原量表中不计分。

unscored_impairment_question.required_implementation: retain separately as unscored optional supplementary item, not ninth/tenth symptom or total. If existing engine cannot exclude it from scoring, HOLD runtime rather than mis-score or silently drop full-form item.
